title: Responsive design and media queries
summary: Adapt layout with fluid grids and a mobile-first media query.

scenario.briefing: The catalog uses a fixed three-column layout that overflows phones. Convert it to a fluid grid that stacks on small screens.

hints: Use display: grid with auto-fit and minmax.
Add a media query for narrow screens.
Stack cards in one column below 600px.
Use .catalog { display: grid; gap: 16px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); } and @media (max-width: 600px) { .catalog { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }.

misconceptions.description: Using a fixed pixel width for the whole layout.
misconceptions.testDescription: A narrow-screen media query stacks the cards.
misconceptions.feedback: Fixed widths overflow small screens. Use fluid grids and media queries.

misconceptions.description: Believing responsive design means only shrinking a desktop layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Responsive design adapts content and layout to the device, not just scaling down.

sections.title: Fluid layouts
sections.body: Use relative units and grid tracks that adapt. auto-fit with minmax creates columns that wrap automatically.

sections.title: Media queries
sections.body: A media query applies rules under conditions such as max-width. Mobile-first designs start with the small-screen layout and enhance upward.

vocabulary.definition: A layout that adapts to available space.
A CSS rule that applies only under specified conditions.
Designing the small-screen layout first, then enhancing.

steps.title: Make the catalog responsive
steps.prompt: Edit styles.css. Convert the fixed grid to a fluid grid and stack on small screens.

files.content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Catalog</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <section class="catalog">
    <article class="card">A</article>
    <article class="card">B</article>
    <article class="card">C</article>
  </section>
</body>
</html>

.catalog { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 300px 300px 300px; gap: 16px; }
.card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #D6D6D6; }

tests.description: The catalog uses a grid layout.
A narrow-screen media query stacks the cards.
The grid uses minmax for fluid columns.

hints: Replace the fixed columns with auto-fit and minmax.
Use grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); and @media (max-width: 600px) { .catalog { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }.

hints: Media queries change rules by condition.
Select fluid grid and media query; reject desktop-only.
